freeze: Written before executing benchmark; constructor only; not independently preregistered.
padding: One original record length on each side. Reflection excludes endpoint replication (numpy reflect).
preprocessing: Subtract original record mean before any extension. No retuning; positive DFT band doubled, zero all other bins; no decimation.
hann_divide: Use original-length symmetric Hann taper, then divide complex reconstruction by its original weight only in reported interior; no endpoint estimate where weight=0.
known_generators: Explicit complex phasors with real part as observed voltage. Smooth transient phasor is a declared generative reference, not asserted identical to an infinite-line analytic transform.
targets: Primary full injected complex phasor; omitted-sideband case also separately reports desired fundamental target. Neither target is inferred from filtered data.
metrics: interior normalized complex RMS vs full truth
interior max amplitude error vs full truth
interior max phase error where true amplitude >=0.2
gate: Synthetic recovery diagnostic only: interior complex relative RMS <=0.01 AND max phase error <=0.02 rad on true-amplitude-eligible points. No empirical gate revision or physical promotion.
empirical_followup: None in this milestone. Preserve v0.1 empirical 0/891 failure; do not select and apply a winner to reused data.
boundary_uncertainty: No finite guard alone certifies a nonlocal DFT projection. Compare outcomes; a physical continuation/noise bound remains necessary.
